card.name: Local anesthetic dosing and names
card.fires_on: Spaces, punctuation and small words in local anesthetic text (lidocaine, Cetacaine, dental and nerve block dosing). It also fires inside the name Cetacaine.

modes.label: Gaps in dosing tables
modes.description: The space between a nerve block or dental row label and its numbers in an anesthetic dosing table.
modes.example: erve Blocks, e.g., Brachial 1.5 15 to 20 225 to 300 Dental<< >>2 1 to 5 2

modes.label: Linking marks after anesthetic names
modes.description: A space, comma, bracket or small word right after lidocaine, mepivacaine or similar names, before a strength.

modes.label: Inside Cetacaine
modes.description: The middle pieces of the brand name Cetacaine.
modes.example: C<<et>>acaine should not be administered to patients

card.writes: It holds back the word save and its variants, and promotes odd name-ending pieces like ona; the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on spacing and small words around local anesthetic names and doses, such as lidocaine and Cetacaine.
